title: Work along a displacement
target: Calculate work and identify when a force does no work.
criteria: Identify the force component along displacement.
Use meters and newtons to obtain joules.
Distinguish effort from mechanical work on an object.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A crate moves horizontally while a person pulls at an upward angle. Which part of the pull determines its work on that horizontal displacement?
options: The full magnitude regardless of angle.
The horizontal component along the displacement.
cpa.guide: Work is the force-displacement dot product; only the parallel component contributes.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: An object moves east while a force acts north. What is that force’s work over the eastward displacement?
options: Equal to force divided by distance.
Negative because north is not east.
cpa.guide: A perpendicular force has zero component along displacement.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A constant 14 N pull acts along a 2.5 m displacement. What is work by that pull?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 30 N force acts forward through 40 cm. What is its work?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A person holds a heavy bag stationary. What is mechanical work done on the bag by the supporting force during the stationary interval?
options: Positive solely because the person feels effort.
Equal to the bag’s weight in joules.
Zero, because the bag’s displacement is zero.
cpa.guide: Mechanical work on the bag requires displacement; bodily energy use is a different account.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A mover pushes against an immovable cabinet for 10 s. Which statement separates effort from work on the cabinet?
options: Mechanical work equals force times waiting time.
All expended body energy must become cabinet kinetic energy.
The mover may expend energy even though the force does no mechanical work on the stationary cabinet.
Any effort proves a nonzero displacement.
cpa.guide: The cabinet has no displacement. Muscles can still consume energy internally.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
